agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario has two circles on near-head-on trajectory with relative speed ~58 m/s and gap 0.058. In one dt (0.00357s, 6 substeps) they collide and energy jumps from 3712 J to 23651 J (6.3x) despite restitution <1 and no controller work. Post-collision speeds increase: body 1 from 16.3 to 51.8 m/s and body 0 remains ~38 m/s, indicating impulse added energy instead of removing it. Flipping body 0 vx to -42 to make bodies separate removes collision and energy stays conserved, confirming collision response is cause. Likely sign or restitution term error in impulse magnitude / velocity update that injects energy when normal relative velocity is large.
